description: Content-Security-Policy audit — Parses a Content-Security-Policy header or <meta> value and reports every clause that weakens it: 'unsafe-inline' without nonces or hashes, 'unsafe-eval', wildcard hosts, data:/blob: in script-src, scheme-only https:, duplicate directives (second is discarded), missing base-uri or object-src 'none', open frame-ancestors or form-action, and the strict-dynamic cases that silently ignore host sources

deployTarget.description: Reserved for future harsher checks in enforce mode.

policy.description: The full Content-Security-Policy value (not the header line).

name: csp-audit
